outcome: Pregnancy complications (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, preterm birth)
finding: While IVF-ET pregnancies in women of advanced maternal age were associated with higher rates of pregnancy complications and lower birth weights, these differences were largely attributed to the increased incidence of multiple pregnancies in the IVF group.
mod_finding: The ART group had a higher rate of cesarean section compared to the natural pregnancy group (90.5% vs 76.2%).
birth_weight: Lower in the ART group (2882.61 ± 657.70 g vs 3223.05 ± 534.28 g)
